name: Mattermost
description: Let people start and continue Paperclip work with an agent from Mattermost.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in Mattermost start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.

credentialFields.label: Bot token
credentialFields.placeholder: Paste the bot account's access token

methods.guidanceMd: Create one dedicated bot account (System Console > Integrations > Bot Accounts), add it to one team and the channels it should answer in, then connect your server URL, the team ID, and the bot token. Paperclip receives messages over the bot's WebSocket and starts one thread per root bot mention. Buttons for approvals and questions need Mattermost to reach Paperclip's public chat webhook URL.
